instruction.text: Sieh dir das Diagramm an und wähle die jeweils richtige Aussage aus.

b: The number of electric cars in Germany decreased gradually between 2019 and 2022.
++The number of electric cars in Germany increased sharply between 2020 and 2022.
In recent years, the number of electric cars in Germany has dropped slightly.
In 2021, there are less electric cars than in 2020.
Before 2022, there is a slight decrease from 137,000 to 54,000 cars.
++Between 2017 and 2019, there is a gradual increase from 34,000 to 83,000 cars.
atoms.sound: Between twothousandseventeen and twothousandnineteen, there is a gradual increase from 34,000 to 83,000 cars.

b: ++From 2021 to 2022, the number of electric cars doubled.
From 2018 to 2021, the number of electric cars doubled.
From 2018 to 2019, the number of electric cars remained constant.
atoms.sound: From twothousandtwentyone to twothousandtwentytwo, the number of electric cars has doubled.

b: In 2020, the lowest number of electric cars was reached with 137,000.
++In 2022, the highest number of electric cars was reached with 618,000.
In 2019, the lowest number of electric cars was reached with 83,000.
atoms.sound: In twothousandtwentytwo, the highest number of electric cars was reached with 618,000.

instruction.text: Sieh dir das Diagramm zur Wahl der Wahlpflichtfächer an und entscheide anschließend, ob die Aussagen wahr oder falsch sind.
